title: Making Judicial Reasoning Visible: Structured Annotation of Holding, Evidentiary Considerations, and Subsumption in Criminal Judgments
reasoning: The paper focuses on the computational classification of judicial reasoning components (Holding, Evidentiary Considerations, and Subsumption) within criminal judgments. While it mentions the potential to analyze judicial fairness and value judgments for legal sociology, it does not evaluate or benchmark religion, spiritual traditions, or specific ethical/moral frameworks as defined in the instructions.
